title: Sign in and enter the panel
description: This verifies a user can log in with email and password, complete any required organization selection, and reach the authenticated dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Verify the authenticated dashboard is displayed
Verify the user is signed in

title: Create a hasta contact and see it in the list
description: DOMAIN-02: create a Hasta-type contact on /contacts with separate first/last name and source→medium cascade; confirm it appears under the default Hasta type filter.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /contacts (nav label Kişiler)
Verify the type filter (aria-label Tür filtresi) defaults to Hasta
Click Yeni kişi and fill #c-first-name, #c-last-name, #c-type=Hasta, phone, email
Set #c-source to Dijital Reklam, #c-medium to Meta Ads, optional campaign
Submit with Oluştur
Verify detail page shows display_name and four cards (Finans özeti, Randevular, Dosyalar, Hasta notları)
Click ← Kişiler
Verify the new contact appears in the list

title: Edit a hasta contact and confirm the updated detail view
description: DOMAIN-02: open a Hasta contact on /contacts, update phone via #c-phone, and confirm detail shows the new value; finance links use ?contact=.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the email field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Navigate to /contacts
Create or open a Hasta contact
Click Düzenle and update #c-phone
Click Kaydet
Verify updated phone on detail and finance link href contains /finance?contact=

title: Schedule a new appointment
description: Create an appointment for a Hasta contact; when phone/email are missing, assert data-testid=appt-contact-info-warning but save still succeeds (GAP-29).

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Sign in with {{LOGIN_USER}} / {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Create a Hasta contact without phone/email on /contacts
Navigate to /appointments and open Yeni randevu
Select the contact in #appt-contact
Verify appt-contact-info-warning is visible
Fill title and click Oluştur
Verify the appointment appears in the schedule with the contact display_name

title: Create a Klinik contact with firm selection
